hero.title: Compare your transcript

hero.subtitleSignedIn: Subject and grade are still missing. Then you see your rank.

upload.error: The file could not be read.
upload.applied: Applied. Your rank is up to date.

curve.alt: Distribution of grades from 1.0 to 5.0. The largest share is at 2.3.
curve.caption: Sample data, not real grades. Your own grade is not drawn in here yet.

verify.confirmedBody: Your subject and grade are saved.
